summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release inviting shareholders to a quarterly update webinar. The webinar will cover operational progress at the Estelle gold and antimony project, exploration results, and a proposed redomiciliation to the US. No deal terms, prices, or special-situation event are disclosed. The filing is a routine investor update, not a special situation. As a foreign private issuer Form 6-K, it is equivalent to a voluntary current report under US securities law.
